facts.text: Oklahoma Wesleyan University anchors its liberal arts education in Four Pillars: the Primacy of Jesus Christ, the Priority of Scripture, the Pursuit of Truth, and the Practice of Wisdom.

sources.title: About OKWU | Private Christian University in Oklahoma
sources.quote: Through deliberate study, honest questions, and critical engagement, we foster a vibrant liberal arts community that upholds the Primacy of Jesus Christ, the Priority of Scripture, the Pursuit of Truth, and the Practice of Wisdom.

facts.text: OKWU offers tuition discounts up to 75% for students whose parents are employed as full-time pastors or missionaries in The Wesleyan Church.

sources.title: Wesleyan Students - Oklahoma Wesleyan University
sources.quote: If one of your parents is employed as a full-time pastor or missionary in The Wesleyan Church, you could be eligible for 75% off your tuition costs.
